capture: Actual baseline source, ordinary Wait and F5 handlers, disposable room-test roots; no field stripping.

inventory.name: Tallow Torch
inventory.description: A rush dipped in rendered fat. It smells of the animal it came from. It will burn for a while.

inventory.name: Crow Jerky
inventory.description: Strips of dried crow meat. It tastes exactly as you would expect. It sustains you regardless.

inventory.name: Water Flask
inventory.description: A clay flask of water. It is flat and has the faint taste of the vessel. It is better than nothing, which is the alternative.

inventory.name: a crude blade
inventory.description: Iron, poorly kept. It will serve.

inventory.name: a leather jack
inventory.description: Cured hide, stitched with sinew. Old work. It will hold.

inventory.name: moist pebble
inventory.description: Perpetually damp. Woven round with twine by hands that knew what they were doing. Certain stones feel different when this is on thy person.

items.name: a letter
items.description: Folded paper. Someone meant to send this.

items.name: The Faceted Ward
items.description: A warped disc of verdigris bronze, the metal buckled and re-set so many times the original form is barely legible. A face was once pressed into the front — mouth open, eyes shut. Most of the features have been beaten flat. It turns a blow poorly. It is better than nothing.
